findings.title: Unauthenticated RFI notification webhook forges official email and Telegram RFI alerts to company contacts
findings.attacker: Any network party who can POST to the deployed n8n webhook path /rfi-notification
findings.controls: Full webhook JSON: rfi_number, subject, assigned_to, date_required, priority
findings.reach: Skill documents trigger type=webhook path=/rfi-notification with only path+method semantics — no authentication, Header Auth, HMAC, JWT, or allowlist anywhere in the template
findings.gain: 1) Look up company Contacts in Google Sheets by attacker-chosen assigned_to role. 2) Send forged official RFI emails to the resolved contact email via the configured Email node. 3) Send forged Telegram RFI alerts (with portal deep-link) to the contact telegram_id. Enables spear-phishing and process disruption using company notification channels.
attack_chain: Operator/agent deploys the RFI Notification Workflow with Google Sheets Contacts, Email, and Telegram credentials configured.
Attacker discovers the n8n host and POSTs to /webhook/rfi-notification (or Cloud webhook URL for that path).
Webhook accepts body with no auth check; parse_rfi copies attacker fields into the item.
get_recipient filters Contacts where role equals attacker assigned_to (e.g. Architect / Project Manager).
send_email delivers forged [RFI …] subject/body to the looked-up corporate email.
send_telegram delivers forged RFI alert + portal link to the looked-up telegram_id.
evidence: 1_DDC_Toolkit/Document-Control/rfi-management/SKILL.md:556-568 (Email to resolved contact with forged RFI content)
1_DDC_Toolkit/Document-Control/rfi-management/SKILL.md:570-582 (Telegram sendMessage with forged RFI + portal link)
findings.mitigations_checked: No authentication/hmac/headerAuth/jwt/secret/allowlist strings in the n8n Integration section. Recipients are resolved from Sheets (not raw webhook email), but any valid role still targets real staff with attacker-controlled RFI content.
findings.remediation: Require webhook Header Auth or HMAC. Bind assigned_to to a server-side role allowlist. Rate-limit notifications. Prefer signing internal events from the RFI system rather than accepting anonymous POSTs. Quarantine/human-confirm before emailing RFIs from webhook ingress.
findings.notes: Distinct from already-reported n8n-daily-report and n8n-photo-report unauth webhooks (different skill/path/impact). Distinct from Telegram bot allowlist findings (this is HTTP webhook → Sheets → Email/Telegram).
